chunks: The day He will gather them together along with those they worshipped other than God, He will ask them: "Did you lure these creatures of Mine away, or did they themselves go astray?"
ai.seo_question: Who will be held accountable on the Day of Judgment for false worship: the idols or the worshippers?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Furqan, this verse underscores the ultimate accountability of both the worshippers and their false deities, a concept central to Shia exegesis which often interprets 'what they worship besides Allah' to include angels, jinn, or righteous humans elevated to divine status. The rhetorical question posed by Allah highlights the mutual deception inherent in idolatry, serving as a profound lesson on the distinction between true monotheism (Tawhid) and the attribution of divinity to created beings.
